title: Select exact same-Client Transfer destinations from local directory evidence

requirements.invariant: A Transfer destination selection contains only other active Projects in the same Account whose exact non-null ClientID equals the source Project ClientID; Business Inventory, the source Project, archived Projects, missing/different Clients, and equal-name/different-ID Projects are excluded.

The destination action can distinguish at least one locally eligible route from no eligible destination, while unresolved or incomplete local directory evidence never masquerades as an authoritative empty result.

Every offered destination produces the already-validated direct ProjectTransferRoute for the same Account and Client, never introduces a Business Inventory hop, and does not itself create a Transfer, Transaction, Item move, Invoice effect, payment, refund, or credit.

The immutable source-bound selection snapshot preserves a query fingerprint, source directory fingerprint, completeness, ready/partial/stale quality, LocalDataVersion, as-of time and deterministic candidate order; authoritative empty and incomplete local scope remain different states.

One small backend-neutral TransferDestinationSelectionQuerying read port returns only typed Ledger/standard Swift values through Swift concurrency; it exposes no generic picker, collection/path/SQL string, SDK listener or write capability.

This Phase 1 selection boundary is executable with synthetic deterministic evidence while the released Firebase app remains unchanged and no Transfer command, schema, provider, source transform, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: TransferDestinationCandidate binds one destination ProjectSummary to the exact validated ProjectTransferRoute from the selected source and revalidates AccountID, ClientID, ProjectID and active destination on construction and decoding.

TransferDestinationSelectionSnapshot filters one validated Account-scoped ProjectListSnapshot without name matching, preserves source directory order, refuses duplicate or mismatched candidate identity, and binds its fingerprint to the source AccountID/ProjectID/ClientID plus directory fingerprint.

TransferDestinationAvailability is available when at least one exact candidate exists, noEligibleDestination only for a complete ready empty result, and directoryIncomplete for partial/stale empty evidence.

TransferDestinationSelectionQuerying exposes only watchTransferDestinations(source:) local read updates; TransferDestinationSelectionFailure exposes stable bounded scope/candidate/fingerprint/encoding codes.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 provider-free projection creates no Client/Project/Transfer table, relationship, check, index, view or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No TransferItems command, authorization, lock, operation envelope, idempotent result, Transaction pair or authoritative revalidation handler is implemented.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Exact local Account/Client equality is not authorization. No server row, membership/financial predicate, grant or RLS policy exists in this slice.

syncStreams.notApplicable: The read port consumes validated local directory evidence but defines no PowerSync Stream, parameter, local table, download predicate or provider readiness claim.

items: Candidate and selection values are immutable Codable evidence; decoding reconstructs through exact route, candidate, completeness and source-bound fingerprint validation.

Ready complete empty evidence yields noEligibleDestination, whereas partial or stale empty evidence yields directoryIncomplete; valid candidates remain visibly available with their underlying quality/readiness evidence.

Canonical sorted-key evidence round-trips byte-identically without disk, database, network or provider state; source/directory mismatch, invalid candidate route, duplicate destination and fingerprint tamper fail atomically.

storageMedia.notApplicable: No Item, receipt, Client or Project attachment ID, byte, path, URL, cache, upload, retention or deletion behavior exists.

appMcp.notApplicable: The shared selection port/read-model semantics are defined, but no current Swift picker, accessibility behavior, MCP query projection, transport handler or entry point is wired.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase Project/clientName is decoded or correlated. Later migration must resolve every Project to one reviewed Client or quarantine it; text equality never makes a candidate eligible.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failure codes are contract values only; no telemetry emission, metric, alert or runbook action is added.

items: The implementation remains inside the provider-free LedgerTargetCore and test targets and is not linked by changing either application project.
The slice cannot authorize or queue a Transfer, choose Items or accounting effects, define provider/schema/migration behavior, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.
O-002/O-011–O-015 and D-017 remain outside the destination-selection boundary and cannot be inferred from a locally valid route.

verification.expected: A mixed synthetic Account directory yields only other active Projects with the exact same AccountID and ClientID, preserving directory order and exact validated routes while equal display names have no effect.
Available, authoritative-no-destination and incomplete-directory states are distinct and preserve exact directory completeness, quality, LocalDataVersion, as-of time and source-bound query evidence.
Representative available/empty/incomplete source-bound selection evidence round-trips byte-identically through canonical restart and an in-memory query port without opening local or remote state.

Source/directory Account mismatch, route/destination mismatch, duplicate candidate IDs, invalid completeness and tampered source/directory/selection fingerprints fail atomically with stable non-enumerating codes.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming command, authorization, schema, provider, migration or production behavior.

notes: Decision-independent Phase 1 selection/read foundation only. It implements exact D-003/D-005/D-006 destination eligibility and local readiness over the already-verified directory and route values, but no Item selection, Transfer command/pair write, D-017 amount, Invoice/Space/tag/correction/credit effect, schema/RLS/Sync/provider, app/MCP, migration, hosted resource, production access or cutover behavior.
